title: Ordered list
description: Enhances an <ol>: stepped and timeline variants, number style, start number, indent and item spacing.

variant.description: List style. stepped draws numbered step badges; timeline draws a connected timeline.

numberType.description: CSS list-style-type for the numbers (decimal, lower-alpha, upper-roman, ...). Ignored by the stepped and timeline variants, which draw their own.

indentSize.description: Left indent of the list (any CSS length). Ignored by the stepped and timeline variants.

_metadata.derivedFrom: the behavior implementation — every property here is one the code actually reads
